## Description

/settings with tabs: Profile (clinic name, logo "Shown on prescriptions, invoices and the patient portal", address, registration numbers, contact), Locations (multiple sites, rooms/resources such as procedure room), Hours (operating hours per location, weekday toggles), Holidays (closures; booking blocked). Notifications and Data tabs are MDV-P1-006; Doctors/Staff tabs are MDV-P1-007/008; Services is P4.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Owners/admins can edit profile and locations; other roles get 403 (server-side).
- [ ] **AC2.** A holiday blocks new bookings on that date for the location and lists existing appointments that need moving.
- [ ] **AC3.** Logo upload is validated (type, size), malware-scanned, stored in private Blob and served via time-limited link.
- [ ] **AC4.** Every settings change is written to the audit log with before/after (no PHI involved).
- [ ] **AC5.** Settings work in English/Hindi/Arabic with RTL.
